title: Piplup's Bubble-Berg
description: A bright-eyed Piplup waves from a compact sculpted ice floe while an orange fish escapes into three rising bubbles. Rounded cheeks, an inlaid navy forehead, a broad curved bill, webbed feet, scalloped collar and swept flippers retain the original character and story.
